texts.preamble: Kailas Balkisan Loya vs The State Of Maharashtra on 15 February, 2019 Author: V.K. Jadhav Bench: V.K. Jadhav 1 Aba 119.2019.odt In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay Bench At Aurangabad Anticipatory Bail Application No.119 Of 2019 Kailas Balkisan Loya Versus The State Of Maharashtra ... Advocate for Applicant : Mr. Salunke Sudarshan J App for Respondent : Mr. B V Virdhe ... Coram : V.K. Jadhav, J. Dated: February 15, 2019 ... Per Court :- 1.
texts.facts: The applicant is seeking pre-arrest bail in connection with Crime No.123/2014 registered at Georai Police Station, District Beed for the offences punishable under sections 272, 273, 179, 328 of IPC and u/s 3 (1) )(zz) (v), 26 (z) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
texts.arguments: 2. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the except the statement of the co-accused, there is no other connecting evidence as against the applicant. His antecedents are clear. The learned counsel for the applicant submits that, during the pendency of the Kailas Balkisan Loya vs The State Of Maharashtra on 15 February, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/184683991/ 1 aaa/- ::: Uploaded on - 15/02/2019 ::: Downloaded on - 16/02/2019 04:19: 2 ABA 119.2019.odt application bearing Criminal application No.5990/2014 before this Court, he was protected by interim order and by order dated 17.12.2014 this Court while disposing of the said application granted liberty to the applicant to apply a fresh for confirmation of the order passed on 17.12.2014 in criminal application no.5990/2014. However, the applicant has not filed any application, but the charge sheet has been submitted and except the evidence as aforesaid, there is no connecting evidence as against the applicant.
